words.gloss_range: the definite singular eschatological title, locally selecting the striking-calamity sense and presenting the event as an active impact-name with explanation withheld
words.root_gloss_range: broad q-r-ʿ range around striking, knocking, severe calamity, checking by warning, drawing lots, stripping bare, and other branch-specific senses; the local proper-name form selects striking calamity while allowing only narrowed pressure from some neighboring branches
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَارِعَةُ}} ({{tr:al-qāriʿa}}) opens as a one-word, definite, singular title: the event is not introduced by a preface but placed before the listener as the named strike. Grammatically, the nominative nominal form can stand as a subject-title with its predicate left unsaid, so the first ayah closes on the name before the following questions reopen it (101:2-3). The selected lexical branch is the striking calamity: the root's knock and impact field makes the Day arrive as forceful contact and interrupting summons rather than as a neutral abstract label. The feminine active-participle shape keeps agency inside the noun, making the event the one that strikes while still sounding like a named catastrophic event rather than a personal striker; that action-title pattern also links this opening to other eschatological openings (69:1, 56:1, 80:33, 79:34). Several root-family pressures survive only in narrowed form: rebuke, exposure after stripping, and lot-like decision can describe how the impact confronts, unveils, and settles outcomes, but they do not make every dictionary branch locally active. The recurrence of the same ending across the opening sequence (101:1-3), together with the hard consonant texture and audible article boundary, turns the title into a repeated lexical and phonetic blow. The rare-root distribution also matters: a calamity denied in 69:4 is isolated here as the surah-opening title, while 13:31 and 101:2-3 keep the root concentrated in calamity and title uses. Variant readings add apparatus: the accusative reading tilts the title toward exclamation, and the imāla reading sharpens vowel color, but neither replaces the canonical nominative title.

topics.headline: standalone nominative title with delayed predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one-word opening is grammatically compressed: the name stands first, while explanation is withheld for the next questions (101:2-3).
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a definite nominative noun functioning as a nominal subject with a strongly licensed omitted predicate; this supports compression and delayed explanation rather than an ordinary completed sentence.

topics.headline: accusative variant as exclamatory apparatus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that case variation can expose an exclamatory stance toward the named strike, while the canonical local form remains the nominative title.
topics.reason: The accusative reading helps explain exclamatory force and a suppressed governor, but QAC and attachment evidence for this aligned surface keep the local parse nominative with an omitted predicate.

topics.headline: definiteness turns the striker into the named event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the article and singular shape make this a recognized title, not a warning about any possible calamity.
topics.reason: The local word is definite, singular, and tagged as a proper noun; contextual evidence treats the referent as an abstract concept, fitting a title-like named event.

topics.headline: impact-root makes the event an acting calamity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the Day named by what it does: it strikes, knocks, and confronts before any later scene describes it.
topics.reason: V4 includes an accepted striking-calamity branch for this root, and QAC identifies the local form as an active participial proper noun naming the eschatological event.

topics.headline: feminine active participle makes an action-title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title names the Day through an action-like feminine participle, aligning it with other eschatological openings (69:1, 56:1, 80:33, 79:34).
topics.reason: The morphology is a feminine active participle used as a proper eschatological title; the comparison to other action-like title openings is a distributional payoff, not a new local sense.

topics.headline: secondary root branches remain pressure, not local activation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the strike as confronting, exposing, and outcome-settling, while still knowing that the local word selects the striking-calamity branch.
topics.reason: V4 accepts branches for warning, lot-drawing, and stripping, so those images can survive as narrowed pressure; the local proper-name noun does not license the composite claim that all dictionary branches are simultaneously active.

topics.headline: same word becomes a three-beat opening refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title is not a one-off label; it is handed into the question and meta-question that follow (101:2-3).
topics.reason: Attachment support warns that the one-ayah rendering should be read with the following questions, and the CRITICAL rows give the concrete recurrence across 101:1-3.

topics.headline: sound texture reinforces impact without changing meaning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the word's abruptness, consonant roughness, and recitational variants as acoustic reinforcement of the strike-image.
topics.reason: The one-word ayah and retained article boundary support abrupt sound payoff; the imāla row is narrowed because it changes recitational color without replacing the root or referent.

topics.headline: rare root links 69:4 to the 101:1 title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare root is concentrated in calamity and title uses, with the denied object in 69:4 isolated here as a surah-opening title.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles mark the exact root-form as low-occurrence and proper-name/abstract-concept oriented; the CRITICAL rows provide the concrete distributional links to 13:31, 69:4, and 101:2-3.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. The blow that opens the whole mechanism. Evidence: ق ر ع B001, striking one thing against another; ق ر ع B006, warning/rebuke that checks the hearer. Structural cue: the one-word nominal opening is repeated in 101:2 and made unknowable in 101:3. Mechanism: impact first arrives as a name, then as an interrogated object, then as an epistemic shock. Abductive move: I supply the causal movement from sound-impact to cognitive arrest. Reading change: القارعة is not only an event-label; it is a blow whose first target is attention and recognition.

2. A public exposed place. Evidence: ق ر ع B010, open high surface of road/courtyard; ق ر ع B008/B011, bare or scraped surface. Structural cue: 101:4-5 display people and mountains stripped from stable places into visible dispersed matter. Mechanism: the "striking" event also creates an exposed arena where coverings and settled forms are removed. Abductive move: I infer that repeated naming turns the event into the place/plane on which later transformations appear. Reading change: القارعة can be read spatially as the exposed surface of manifestation, not only temporally as a coming disaster.

3. A selector before the scales. Evidence: ق ر ع B004, casting lots/drawing shares; و ز ن B002 in 101:6/8, balance of justice; ث ق ل B001 and خ ف ف B001, heaviness/lightness. Structural cue: the surah moves from the repeated قارعة to paired outcomes by weight. Mechanism: the striking event functions like a decisive selection process that separates shares into heavy and light cases. Abductive move: I supply the legal-apportioning analogy between lot-casting and weighing. Reading change: القارعة becomes the onset of adjudicative sorting.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 101:6-8 surprised me by activating ق ر ع B004: the first "striking" also behaves like a selector before the scales. 101:4-5 also made ق ر ع B010/B008 visible: the blow creates an exposed, stripped field where people and mountains are displayed.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Impact propagated through unlike bodies.** `ق ر ع B001` supplies striking one thing against another. The isolated noun is followed by its repetition, two questions, then parallel transformations of people and mountains in 101:4-5. The branch functions as an initiating impact whose effects propagate through both living movement and solid mass. The packet supplies no explicit impact arrow between the title and those transformations, so that transmission is the abductive link. The one-word ayah reads less as a title alone and more as the first blow whose consequences the following ayat display.

2. **A warning that arrests before it explains.** `ق ر ع B006` is "restraining by a striking warning." Isolation in 101:1, repetition in 101:2-3, and delayed description create a discourse sequence of interruption before disclosure. This branch gives the noun the role of checking the hearer and forcing attention. I infer that formal delay performs the restraint described by the branch; the text supplies repetition and questioning but does not label their effect. `ٱلْقَارِعَةُ` therefore reads simultaneously as an event and as an utterance that strikes its audience into attention.

3. **Exploratory stripping of established structure.** `ق ر ع B008` carries bareness, stripping, and emptied enclosures. People are scattered in 101:4, while mountains are converted from compact masses into fluffed wool in 101:5. The branch acts as the event's de-structuring operation: social and geological aggregates lose the coverings or cohesion by which they appeared stable. The causal assignment to `ٱلْقَارِعَةُ` is inferred from sequence rather than stated. On this activation, the noun names not only a collision but an occurrence that leaves established forms bare.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The repetition and questions in 101:2-3 confirmed that `ق ر ع B006` operates at discourse level before any physical scene appears. The transformations in 101:4-5 then supplied the delayed evidence for `ق ر ع B001` and `ق ر ع B008`. Finally, the first `فَأَمَّا مَن` scale clause in 101:6 weakly activated `ق ر ع B004`, decisive apportionment: weighing is not lot-casting, but the event now also begins to allocate a case.

findings.text: Tek sözcüklü ad, etkileri insan kalabalığına ve dağların yapısına yayılan ilk darbe gibi işler.
Felaketin adı, açıklamadan önce dinleyeni durdurup dikkat kesilmeye zorlayan bir uyarı edimi de olur.
Sonraki dağılıp çözülmeler, bu darbenin yerleşik biçimleri çıplak bırakan bir söküm gücü taşıdığını gösterir.
Olayın yol ya da avlu gibi açık bir yüzey anlamı, sonraki dönüşümlerin sergilendiği çıplak bir alan düşündürür.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Blow, Descent, and Dispersive Impact
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A blow or downward cast strikes a target and sends what was gathered into scattered motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: striking or knocking (ق ر ع:B001/m01); reaching or striking with hand or weapon (ه و ي:B003/m01); casting down (ه و ي:B003/m02); scattering after impact (ب ث ث:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 مبثوث (ب ث ث); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The قارعة is read through the concrete action of one thing striking another. The hand or weapon descends toward its object, and the impact converts cohesion into broadcast fragments or bodies.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cranial Breach and Gaping Wound
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A strike crosses the outer head, reaches a thin cranial layer, and leaves an opened wound.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: head-strike (ق ر ع:B001/m01); cranial and bone plates (ف ر ش:B010/m01); wound reaching the bone layer (ف ر ش:B011/m01); brain or cranial membrane (ء م م:B003/m01); wound reaching the brain (ء م م:B003/m02); opened wound-mouth (ه و ي:B007/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م) and هاوية (ه و ي)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The striking action becomes a bodily penetration scene: force breaks through the head, reaches the thin supporting layer, and exposes the deeper cranial center as a gaping interior.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Hard Ground, Pointed Tool, and Stabilized Edge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sharpened implement meets an unyielding substrate, while stonework fixes the edge of the opening.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hard ground that stops digging (ج ب ل:B005/m01); hard stripped surface (ق ر ع:B011/m01); pointed horn or implement (د ر ي:B004/m01); stones lining a well (ح م ي:B011/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person or possession acquires weight, is selected as the best, and becomes socially elevated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: precious or weighty thing (ث ق ل:B005/m01); eminent person (ث ق ل:B005/m02); social worth (و ز ن:B007/m01); selected chief or best portion (ق ر ع:B007/m01); leaders likened to mountains (ج ب ل:B012/m01)

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hayvanların çiftleşme ve damızlık kullanımıyla sınırlıdır; genel vurma, rastgele seçim veya önderlik anlamına genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir seçim veya paylaşım sonucunu belirlemek için kişiler arasında kura düzenlemek, kuraya katılmak ve sonucu kuraya göre belirlemektir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإقراع بين القوم أو الشركاء، والقرعة، والاقتراع، والمقارعة إذا نصت على المساهمة والقسمة أو خروج السهم.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sarsıcı büyük felaket ve dünyanın sonundaki hesap günüyle sınırlıdır; koruyucu okuma kullanımı yalnızca kendi sözcük biriminde gösterilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın felaket anlamını ve onun dünyanın sonundaki hesap gününe uygulanmasını verir; sözcük birimi ayrıntıları çekirdeğe eklenmez.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal söz dinleyip geri dönme ile başkasını durdurma veya kınama yönlerini ayırır; pişmanlık hareketi yalnızca kendi kalıbına aittir.

Sertçe azarlama ve kınama, muhatabı yanlış davranıştan caydırmaya yönelir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi güvenilen önderi veya seçilmiş kişiyi, malın en iyi bölümünü, evin en iyi yerini ve birine malın en iyisini vermeyi birlikte destekler. Ortak eksen seçilmişlik ve üstün niteliktir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kişi, mal veya yer içindeki seçkin ve en iyi olana ilişkindir; rastgele kura sonucu ve damızlık eylemi bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım seçkin kişi ile mal veya yerin en iyi kısmını ayırır; en iyi malı verme anlamı yalnızca ilgili yapıya bağlı tutulur.

facets.statement: Bir kişi seçilmiş, üstün ve işlerde kendisine güvenilen önder olarak öne çıkar.

Bir evin sıcak veya soğuk bakımından en elverişli yeri, yerin en iyi bölümü sayılır.
Bir kişiye malın sıradan bir bölümünü değil, en iyi ve seçkin bölümünü vermek anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi sert ve dayanıklı nesne veya yeri, ayrıca çakılla ovulmuş kabı destekler. Toynak ve işkembenin sertleşmesi yalnızca ayrı sözcük biriminde tanıklanmıştır; bu nedenle dal tanımı sertlik ile kazınıp düzleşmiş yüzeyi ayırarak kurulmuştur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın sertlik yönüyle ovulmuş veya soyulmuş yüzey yönünü ayırır; toynak ve işkembe kalıbı genel anlama yayılmaz.

morphemes_tsv.note: ayah attribution taken from morpheme_id/word_id, never from the qac_ref column: basmalah rows are a000 but carry surah 1's qac_refs

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref resolves against qac_morphemes for this ayah

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_focus_trace_hermetic.note: Hermetic Focus Trace not requested for this bundle. Rebuild with --include-focus-trace, or --require-focus-trace when reader JSON must be present.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
